title: Tiny, cute popsicle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- popsicle body: main ice part -->
  <rect x='35' y='10' width='30' height='45' rx='14' ry='14' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- lighter edge highlight on left -->
  <rect x='38' y='14' width='8' height='37' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#FFA8C5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- second flavour layer lower ice -->
  <rect x='35' y='40' width='30' height='15' rx='8' ry='8' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <!-- highlight on lower layer -->
  <rect x='39' y='42' width='7' height='10' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#FFE9A8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- bite mark top right -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='17' r='7' fill='#1A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='12' r='4' fill='#1A2A4A'/>
  <!-- cute face - eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='33' r='3' fill='#3A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='33' r='3' fill='#3A2A4A'/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='32' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='32' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 39 Q50 44 55 39' stroke='#3A2A4A' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='38' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#FF4466' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='38' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#FF4466' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- popsicle stick -->
  <rect x='46' y='52' width='8' height='24' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#E8B86D'/>
  <!-- stick shade edge -->
  <rect x='46' y='52' width='3' height='24' rx='1.5' ry='1.5' fill='#F5D9A0'/>
  <!-- little shine on stick -->
  <rect x='52' y='56' width='1.5' height='14' rx='0.7' fill='#C89850'/>
</svg>
